title: Tables and Table Structure
summary: Use table, caption, thead, tbody, tr, th, and td for tabular data.

sketchBlocks.title: Use a table for row-and-column relationships
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Tables are for data where values relate across rows and columns. Use `<table>` for the structure, `<tr>` for each row, `<th>` for header cells, and `<td>` for data cells.

A list is better for a simple collection; a table is better when each row shares the same fields.

sketchBlocks.title: Separate headers from data with thead and tbody
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
`<thead>` groups header rows and `<tbody>` groups the main data rows. This makes a larger table easier to understand.

Use one `<tr>` per row and keep the same logical columns from row to row.

quizDraft.title: Turn meeting data into a table
quizDraft.prompt: Replace the two meeting paragraphs with a table captioned Weekly club meetings. Add Club and Day headers, then one row for Robotics Tuesday and one row for Art Thursday.
quizDraft.hint: Each club is one row with the same two columns.

help.concept: A table represents repeated records that share the same fields.
help.hint_1: Start with table and caption, then add a header row.
help.hint_2: Use th for headers and td for the two club rows.

quizDraft.prompt: Keep the existing caption and cells, but group the header row inside thead and the data row inside tbody.

quizDraft.title: Choose table markup for structured data
quizDraft.prompt: Which element represents one row in an HTML table?
quizDraft.hint: Think row, not cell or section.

help.concept: The tr element groups the cells that make up one table row.
help.hint_1: A td is one data cell.
help.hint_2: Choose the element whose name means table row.

quizDraft.title: Recognize table structure
quizDraft.hint: Choose elements whose purposes are part of table structure.

help.concept: th labels header cells and tbody groups body rows.
help.hint_1: One correct answer is a cell type; the other is a row group.
help.hint_2: Ignore elements from other HTML concepts.
